scope: CPU helpers use original captured operands. Q/gate extraction follows each projected head. Residual variance uses the unrounded FP32 sum, while its numerator uses the BF16 endpoint. The original observer did not separately capture the rounded residual; its attention residual is independently constructed from the two captured operands and checked against the CPU output. No captured operand or expected output is connected to native inference.
